facts.text: The hotel sits on a tranquil square surrounded by historic buildings, near Puerta de Sol in the heart of Madrid.
facts.excerpt: Set in a tranquil square surrounded by historic buildings, The Madrid EDITION is near Puerta de Sol in the heart of the Spanish capital

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle of Art, three of Madrid's most important art museums.
facts.excerpt: within walking distance to The Golden Triangle of Art

facts.text: From Sol station, the hotel's Celenque Square is about a 300 m walk down Arenal Street.
facts.excerpt: After arriving at Sol, exit the station and walk down Arenal Street. Celenque Square will be in the right after 300m.

facts.text: The Madrid EDITION is the second EDITION hotel in Spain, after The Barcelona EDITION, which opened in 2018.
facts.excerpt: The Madrid EDITION is the second EDITION Hotel in Spain, following the successful opening of The Barcelona EDITION in 2018.

facts.text: The rooms have modern decor with detailing by Ian Schrager.
facts.excerpt: stylishly modern decor and posh detailing by Ian Schrager

facts.text: Rooms include floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral and Gran Via.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows that feature stunning views of the Royal Palace, the Almudena cathedral and Gran Vía

facts.text: Interconnected rooms are offered for families and groups of up to 8 guests.
facts.excerpt: For families and groups of up to 8 guests, we offer 77 interconnected rooms.

facts.text: Oroya is the hotel's Peruvian restaurant, led by chef Diego Munoz, on the 4th floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 4th floor of The Madrid EDITION is the hotel’s sanctuary overlooking the hustle and bustle of the city. Here, you will find Oroya, the restaurant helmed by Peruvian Chef Diego Muñoz

facts.text: Oroya serves family-style sharing plates such as ceviches, Peruvian-style fried calamari and lucuma desserts.
facts.excerpt: serves a relaxed menu with family-style sharing plates such as tasteful ceviches, Peruvian-style fried calamari or sweet lucuma desserts

facts.text: Oroya is set in a greenhouse-like room framed by a blackened steel cage with climbing plants and coloured glass panels.
facts.excerpt: greenhouse-like setting framed by a blackened steel cage clad with climbing plants and coloured glass panels

facts.text: Oroya won at the Top Cocktail Bars Awards in 2024, for the third consecutive year.
facts.excerpt: that has led Oroya to win at the Top Cocktail Bars Awards in 2024, for the third consecutive year.

facts.text: The Roof, Oroya's terrace, has a fireplace and a vine-covered pergola.
facts.excerpt: The Roof, is an outdoor seductive garden in the sky featuring a fireplace and a vine-covered pergola

facts.text: The Roof terrace is open to hotel residents and the local community alike.
facts.excerpt: open to residents and local community alike

facts.text: Punch Room is an intimate cocktail bar that revives the ritual of punch, the precursor to the modern cocktail.
facts.excerpt: Punch Room Madrid is an intimate cocktail bar that revives the ritual of punch—the precursor to the modern cocktail

facts.text: The Lobby Bar has a pool table sculpted by designer Emmanuel Levet Stenne from a single slab of white Bianco Neve matt marble.
facts.excerpt: a shapely pool table, which designer Emmanuel Levet Stenne sculpted from a single slab of white Bianco Neve matt marble

facts.text: The Lobby Bar furnishings include Jean-Michel Frank sofas and armchairs and rope-covered chairs by Christian Astuguevieille.
facts.excerpt: This includes Jean-Michel Frank sofas and armchairs, recycled bronze stools from Maison Intègre, rope-covered chairs by Christian Astuguevieille

facts.text: The rooftop infinity pool on the fourth floor has views of the Teatro Real, the Royal Palace, the dome of the Almudena Cathedral and Casa de Campo.
facts.excerpt: it offers unique views of Madrid, with the Teatro Real, the Royal Palace, the dome of the Almudena Cathedral, and Casa de Campo forming its backdrop.

facts.text: Pool cabanas are available on request, including for locals and external guests, with priority given to hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Cabanas are available on request, including for locals and external guests, with priority given to hotel guests.

facts.text: The pool will be seasonally closed after October 18, 2026.
facts.excerpt: Please note that the pool will be seasonally closed after October 18, 2026.

facts.text: The Spa has a Finnish dry sauna, steam room and relaxation lounge, and is open to day guests as well as hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Open to both in-house and day guests, The Spa features a Finnish dry sauna, steam room, relaxation lounge

facts.text: The spa menu uses Natura Bisse products and includes the EDITION Signature Massage with a black tea-scented massage oil by Le Labo.
facts.excerpt: The curated treatment menu includes the EDITION Signature Massage, crafted with a custom black tea-scented massage oil by Le Labo

facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre, which guests can use at no charge.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary use of the 24-hour fitness centre

facts.text: Pets are welcome at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome

facts.text: Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi access throughout the hotel

facts.text: A private car from Madrid Barajas Airport takes about 25 minutes depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: a private car to/from Adolfo Suarez Madrid Barajas Airport (15Km) will take approximately 25 minutes depending on the traffic

facts.text: The pool is described as the largest infinity pool in the city.
facts.excerpt: lies the largest infinity pool in the city
